methodology.scope: Local PostgreSQL contention and recovery, not production capacity or a fairness guarantee.
methodology.pool: Retained v0.8 rule: utilization >=.75 sets shared cap1 with critical reservation1; all background work blocked while binding.
methodology.balanced: WaitCount deltas activate 0/1 contention signal; recovery needs200ms with no new waits and a nonfull pool. Existing sharing gives server-owned interactive/batch classes shares3:1, borrowing ceiling4, demandTTL200ms; service4/reserved1 unchanged.
methodology.sampling: 100ms; maxAge1s; timeout50ms; same unknown cap1. No new admission queue, retry, preemption or controller algorithm.
methodology.jobs: 200 offers/sec,6 workers, bounded fixture queue16; 120ms writes vs20ms critical transactions. Rejections/drops/cancellation are retained. Counts include drain.
methodology.traffic: Independent arrivals, database deadline1s, client3s. Same offered traffic and fresh databases; rotating policy/profile order.
